title: Get a permit for outdoor dining on the footpath
what: Get the council's permit before placing tables, chairs or other furniture on a footpath, road or other public land for outdoor dining.

sources.title: Permit to establish an outdoor dining facility hobart city council
sources.publisher: Australian Business Licence and Information Service (ABLIS)
sources.quote: You will need this permit if you intend to operate a food or beverage business and propose to place, erect or construct furniture or goods outside your premises on a footpath, road or reserve or any other public place to encourage outdoor street dining.
